## Problem and change

Describe the trigger, resulting behavior and bounded scope. Link the roadmap slice or tracked issue and the relevant [code-area entry](https://github.com/CapstoneDesign-Fall2026-UlsanCollege/Team_4_Capstone_project/blob/main/docs/Week9/ai-use-and-code-ownership-audit.md#codebase-area-map).

- Issue / roadmap slice:
- Author / area steward or backup consulted (state pending if not confirmed):

## Verification

- Method and executor: source review / local / CI / live / independent teammate.
- Setup, URL or revision, date and device/browser when relevant:
- Expected behavior:
- Observed behavior and PASS / FAIL / NOT TESTED:
- Evidence link and a relevant boundary/failure case:
- Unchecked behavior, owner and next check:

An implementation, build result or prepared test plan establishes only its stated scope. Record actual behavior separately; name an independent tester only if they performed the check.

## AI assistance and responsibility

- [ ] No AI assistance for this change (the author's own declaration).
- [ ] AI helped with planning or explanations.
- [ ] AI generated or edited implementation, tests or documentation.

If AI helped, record:

- Tool and affected files/changes:
- What assistance produced:
- What was inspected or changed afterward, and by whom:
- Human who can explain the result, or explicit pending explain-back:
- Review/test receipt and any unresolved understanding gap:

Update the [ownership audit](https://github.com/CapstoneDesign-Fall2026-UlsanCollege/Team_4_Capstone_project/blob/main/docs/Week9/ai-use-and-code-ownership-audit.md#ai-use-disclosure) for relevant changes. Do not present automated inspection as a human review. An audit does not override assignment restrictions on AI use.

## Outside sources

List any external code, media, data or reference used, its creator/source link, applicable license or permission, and how it was incorporated. State none if applicable; do not infer unknown permissions. Keep credentials and private user data out of code, logs and evidence.

Field guidance: the course's [reusable PR AI-use template](https://github.com/CapstoneDesign-Fall2026-UlsanCollege/course-materials/blob/12926496c4bc533d0997bbcd182b90eb95094c2b/student-starter-kit/templates/pr-with-ai-use-note.md) and [Project Work Policy](https://github.com/CapstoneDesign-Fall2026-UlsanCollege/course-materials/blob/12926496c4bc533d0997bbcd182b90eb95094c2b/student-starter-kit/docs/project-work-policy.md).
